answer_1.quote: ...We conduct comprehensive experiments on two illustrative long-term multi-session daily dialogue datasets, MSC and Conversation Chronicles (CC), to evaluate the effectiveness, generality, and cross-domain capabilities of the proposed framework... the response generation module guides the generation of appropriate responses...
answer_1.outputs: Generated dialogue responses (agent replies) and summarized event memories

answer_2.quote: ...We use three widely used standard metrics: BLEU-N (BL-N), ROUGE-L (R-L), and METEOR (MET) to measure the quality of response generation... Additionally, we employ Distinct-1/2/3 metrics for diversity.

answer_4.quote: ...We employ 8 students to assist with the assessment and evaluate LD-Agent on two tasks: memory retrieval evaluation and response generation evaluation... The results are evaluated on three aspects: coherence, fluency and engagingness.
answer_4.guideline: Human evaluators rate the system on coherence (topic and logic consistency across sessions), fluency (naturalness of interaction), and engagingness (interest and willingness to continue chatting).
